# Openfootball test fixtures

Unmodified `cl.txt` main-draw files from
https://github.com/openfootball/champions-league at revision
`abfaeddc2ee3d14f99ecc163c9ddb46cb4d67cef`.

Source license: CC0-1.0, https://github.com/openfootball/champions-league/blob/abfaeddc2ee3d14f99ecc163c9ddb46cb4d67cef/LICENSE.md

The four fixtures exercise the older group stage, 2019/20's exceptional single-leg rounds,
the new league phase, and extra-time/penalty notation. Raw files are preserved, including the
2024/25 PSV–Juventus annotation error. Its reviewed UEFA erratum is applied explicitly by the
reader, with original text and correction provenance retained in the import metadata.
